newsitem.title: JAPAN: Eisai seeks approval for anti-ulcer drug in UK.
newsitem.headline: Eisai seeks approval for anti-ulcer drug in UK.

text.p: Eisai Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it applied with Britain's Medicines Control Agency last week to produce the anti-ulcer drug Pariet.
The drug, synthesised by the company in Japan, will be used to treat duodenal ulcers, gastric ulcers and gastroesophageal reflux disease, Eisai said in a statement.
The drug is awaiting a government approval for marketing in Japan, and is also going through the third phase of three-stage clinical trials in the United States, the statement said.
The company plans to apply with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in late 1997 for a new drug approval on Pariet.
